positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building planetary intelligence.

Helping store, index, and search through the vast daily imagery archive at Planet.

positions.title: Senior Data Engineer
positions.description: I wrote open-source software for the Firefox Data Platform to improve data driven decision making at Mozilla. Maintained data pipelines using Spark and BigQuery, and contributed toward security-focused applications for privacy-preserving telemetry and social science research.
positions.insights: Apache Spark, Google BigQuery and +1 skill

positions.title: Release Engineering Intern
positions.description:
During my internships, I made contributions to two overlapping build and release infrastructures. 

I created containerized tasks for steps in the Firefox release process. One included a secure signing scheme for signing builds artifacts. I also specified periodic tasks for setting the cadence of nightly builds.

I adapted mozharness scripts to automate Fennec (gecko-android) builds on TaskCluster as nightlies.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
As a part-time intern, I built internal tools and dashboards for Endpoint Protection and an automation harness for Norton. 

I added HTML reporting for tracking changesets between code releases. I scripted a mock checkout flow for reducing subscription overhead. I also launched a workflow tool for hiring managers called ReqCreation.

In another role, I transformed a performance harness written in a custom DSL into a cache-aware Python library.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
I improved interface support on the Cube X by adding touchscreen keyboard for AP access and a protocol for printer discovery. This freed the device from the cabled setup process. 

I added added French, German, Italian, Japanese, and Korean language support to all of the menu pages. The update bundle included a rendered unicode fontset optimized for 128x64 monochromatic screens.

I created a demo print control system with soft realtime constraints on a BeagleBone Black. The gateway included a print submission dialog and a live indicator of the printing progress.
